calls.statement:
SELECT o.status, o.fulfilment_type,
  COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS n_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id AND p.category='ZZ Test') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS utc_date_count
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS distinct_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.cnt IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.test_lines>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.cnt IS NOT NULL AND l.cnt<>o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linecount_mismatch
FROM fact_web_order o
LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.receipt_id, COUNT(*) cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) test_lines
           FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key GROUP BY 1) l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE o.status<>'cancelled'
  AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
